column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE LAND DEVELOPMENT ORDINANCE
(CHAPTER 464)
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-

1.
This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Land  Development
(Amendment) Act, No.     of  2021.

2.
The  Land  Development  Ordinance  (Chapter  464)
(hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby
amended  by  the  substitution  for  the  words  “Land
Commissioner” wherever those words occur in the principal
enactment or in any written law, notice, notification, contract,

communication  or  other  document,  of 
the  words
